body.p: The mob, or‸the trial of Warren Hastings, the death-bed of WashingtonRobert Burns, or Wellington at Waterloo or ‸or Decatur capturing the Macedonian, or the sea-fight of the ConstitutionChesapeake and the Shannon and the Guerrere, or ? and the shatter'dbleedingdying Lawrence carried bleeding below— —‸—during—all these whiles, I say, and, though on a far different lowerdifferent all grade, running parallel with them all, Contemporary with all thesethem all, purpose connecting all those ‸stormy and reverberating events, all these cosmic-sounding names, ‸and for my present purpose connecting and compacting to 80 years a quiet yet active Pesronality rose, and grew to manhood‸not far from where I now speak, and flowed on ‸and out for ‸, its career of over 80 years like some continuous ‸low-down rill of fresh and living water
